name: OWASP_A01_Unauthorized_Admin_Access
search: index=web_logs (uri_path="*/admin/*" OR uri_path="*/dashboard/*" OR uri_path="*/manage/*") | eval user=if(isnull(user) OR user="", "ANONYMOUS", user) | stats count values(status) as http_status_codes values(uri_path) as visited_endpoints by src_ip, user | where (http_status_codes=200 OR http_status_codes=302) AND user="ANONYMOUS"
description: OWASP A01: Autentifikasiya olunmamis istifadecilerin admin panellerine girisini tespit eder.
